automated_tests.scope: 29 rule/example/page checks plus 8 checks against the real loopback JDK service (compile, never execute, name/token/Origin/Host rejection, nothing written to disk)

false_positive_scan.method: Rule engine and generate() over known-valid Java sources: EIE3320 lecture source code ch01-14 (107 files) and this repository's Lab1/Lab2 code (14 files)
false_positive_scan.note: 2.0 suggested List.of, Thread.sleep and enhanced-for variables (e.g. shape -> shapes) as receiver typos

issues.message: toString() 的返回类型是 String。这里仅打印了内容，没有返回值；应把 System.out.println(表达式); 改成 return 表达式;，在调用处打印对象。
可选输出建议（这段语法本身合法）：id + 单引号字符会做数值相加，例如 101 + '|' 是 225。只有题目要求文本分隔符时，才改用 "|"；此改动会改变输出，默认不应用。
这里已在类的大括号外面。Java 17 不能在文件顶层直接写变量、for 循环或打印语句；运行代码应放入 public static void main(String[] args) 方法内。先修结构，才能继续看后面的类型错误。 此草稿按文件名新增 Main 入口类。
data 是 String[] 数组，数组没有 split()。先取出其中一条字符串，再拆字段：data[i].split(",")。
StudentRecord 构造器的第 1 个参数需要 int，而 record[0] 来自 String[]，仍是字符串；使用 Integer.parseInt(record[0]) 转成数字。
StudentRecord 构造器的第 3 个参数需要 double，而 record[2] 来自 String[]，仍是字符串；使用 Double.parseDouble(record[2]) 转成数字。
total 是 double，record[2] 是 String，不能直接 +=；先用 Double.parseDouble 转成数字再累加。

count 是 StudentRecord 的 private static 字段，在外部不能直接使用；已有公开访问方法 StudentRecord.getCount()。

page_interactions.method: Node DOM/event harness executing all delivered inline scripts; not a real-browser visual test
checks: JDK-valid original is preserved and no candidate is generated
original check, generation, candidate compilation, download, apply and undo complete correctly
meaning-changing suggestions start unchecked in direct-file mode
draft persists locally, restores explicitly and can be cleared
filename correction preserves the supplied public class name
service disconnection does not prevent rule generation; reconnect restores verification
all-file precheck includes dependencies and preserves the valid project

compiler_guided_generation.method: Delivered rule scripts plus real loopback JDK compiler; submitted programs not executed
checks: missing import: original compile -> selective generation -> candidate compile verified
deleted class with private field and brace literal: original compile -> selective generation -> candidate compile verified
missing return: original compile -> selective generation -> candidate compile verified
valid numeric char expression: original compile -> selective generation -> candidate compile verified
